mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever wondered what it feels like to grow up caught between two worlds? Together, we're about to step into the lives of families who carry their heritage close, while also chasing the promise and possibilities of a new home. In Rafael Polo's powerful story, "Growing Up American," we journey through the heart of the immigrant experience in the United States. We'll meet people who navigate the push and pull of tradition and change, who wrestle with questions of identity, loyalty, and where they truly belong. As we explore this tapestry of cultures, family bonds, and dreams, you’ll see how every challenge, every small victory, weaves into something uniquely American. So, let’s dive in together—let’s discover what it really means to belong, and how each of us, in our own way, is always finding our place in the world.
